name: Crunchy Coated Chicken Breasts
author: based.cooking contributors

ingredients.item: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, about 6 ounces each

steps: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil
Crush the crackers into a medium bowl.
Add the thyme, Parmesan cheese, and generously salt and pepper. Drizzle with the olive oil and mix well.
Place chicken breasts on cutting board to trim fat and tenderize till flat and even.
Cover the bottom of a large plate with a layer of the crumb mixture.

Salt and pepper both sides of one chicken breast. Coat one side with mustard. Place mustard side down on crumb mixture, then coat the exposed with mustard and pat with crumb mix. Repeat for the other chicken breasts.
Bake for ~ 18 minutes, or until juices run clear and the chicken is fully cooked through.
